summary: The exchange quickly moved from a complaint to defensive explanations, with both partners feeling unheard. Rohit offered a brief apology at the end, but the conversation lacked mutual validation and contained criticism and defensiveness.

patterns.title: Criticism vs Defensiveness
patterns.detail: Kavya points out a repeated behavior (not calling mother) which Rohit meets with a defensive justification.

patterns.title: Lack of Validation
patterns.detail: Rohit does not acknowledge Kavya's feeling of loneliness before shifting to his own perspective.

strengths.title: Apology Offered
strengths.detail: Rohit ends with a clear apology and invites Kavya to share what happened.

strengths.title: Emotion Expressed
strengths.detail: Kavya openly shares feeling of being alone and disappointment about her promotion deadline.

improvements.suggestion: Replace criticism with a soft request and invite dialogue.
improvements.script: Kavya could say, "Mujhe lagta hai ki mummy ko call karna hum dono ke liye important hai, kya hum iske liye ek plan bana sakte hain?"

improvements.suggestion: Rohit should first validate Kavya's feeling before explaining his side.
improvements.script: Rohit could respond, "Mujhe samajh aata hai ki tum akela feel kar rahi ho, aur main uske liye maafi chahta hoon."

improvements.suggestion: Introduce a repair attempt earlier to lower tension.
improvements.script: Rohit could add, "Chalo, aaj shaam ko mummy ko call karte hain, theek hai?"
